answer_2.quote: We define the following evaluation metrics for our content analysis tasks. For various classification tasks, we employ standard multiclass classification accuracy and define the multilabel classification accuracy as ACC = 1 - Hamming Loss. Furthermore, we use the agreement rate—defined as the proportion of text entries where all agents concur—to assess the level of consensus during discussions.

answer_4.quote: Our comprehensive experiments on multiple real‑world datasets demonstrate that SCALE ... and has the ability to approximate human judgment in complex content analysis tasks. ... Extensive Validation. ... analyses by domain experts confirm that SCALE can closely mimic human judgment in content analysis.
answer_4.guideline: Domain experts reviewed the system outputs and assessed whether they matched human coding decisions, focusing on the validity and reliability of the annotations.
